obstacles.provenance: SPEC plus APPROX (BIOBUZZ Competition Manual V1 §9.6, Figs 9-9 to 9-11). Pivot at x = -12.75: the two hives are 25.5 in centre to centre (Fig 9-10) and the pair is centred on the field (Fig 9-2; FIRST's BIOBUZZ field CAD (STEP v26-27.2) agrees). Cell outer face 18.58 in from the pivot in plan: the cells' inner faces are 18.84 in apart and each cell is 12.04 in deep (Fig 9-9), so the outer face is 21.46 in along the bar, times cos 30 degrees for the 30 degree tilt (Fig 9-10). Opening 20 in wide (§9.6.2, Fig 9-11). z from 25.5 in, the bottom of the down hive, to 65.6 in, the top of the up-cell opening (Fig 9-10). The box is an envelope over both cells' full swing footprint, because either cell may be up. APPROX on the 25.5 in floor: FIRST's BIOBUZZ field CAD (STEP v26-27.2) puts the down-cell floor at 31.981 in and the lowest hive structure at rest at 30.652 in, see TRANSCRIPTION.md.
SPEC plus APPROX, inherited from hiveRedPivotBar: its point mirror, with the BLUE pivot at (+12.75, 0) (Fig 9-10). The z range carries the same APPROX 25.5 in floor.

SPEC (FIRST's BIOBUZZ field CAD, STEP v26-27.2, sha256 5e768b73…fe00: the east foot bar, part am-5878 Sheet Metal Foot Bar, spans x 22.750 to 24.735, |y| up to 19.472 and z 0 to 2.148; this box widens it to hold the two feet on it, parts am-5879-A and am-5879-B, which reach |y| 19.477, and their fasteners, whose screw heads reach x 22.548 and 24.754, rounded outward to 0.01 in). SPEC (FIRST's BIOBUZZ field CAD, STEP v26-27.2, sha256 5e768b73…fe00: part am-5876 A-Frame Leg, a 1 in square tube 45.75 in long, cut square at both ends. fromIn and toIn are the centres of its two end faces; the CAD's east and west legs differ by 0.015 in in x, so each value is the mean of the four legs over the field's point mirror, rounded to 0.01 in. radiusIn is the round envelope, rounded up to 0.01 in, that holds every point of the tube after that rounding: 0.707 in to its corners plus 0.014 in). zones.provenance: SPEC (BIOBUZZ Competition Manual TU07 §9.3, Figs 9-2 and 9-3; FIRST's Field Acceptance Checklist V26-27.2 items 3.2 and 3.4; Event Field Setup Guide V1.0 §8.3). From the wall out to 11 in, the checklist's controlled depth (11 ± 0.125 in, inside of the wall to the far edge of the tape). Along the wall, y 23.91 to 46.6 from the centre: the tape's outer edges in FIRST's BIOBUZZ field CAD, STEP v26-27.2, sha256 5e768b73…fe00, just inside tile seams 4 and 5. The CAD's tape far edge is 11.48 in off the wall rail, outside the checklist's tolerance; this file follows the checklist. In our 141.5 in frame: the walls are at ±70.75 (sizeIn), and this is measured from the wall, as on the real field. Zenith's upstream file puts it against a ±72 wall (the manual's nominal 144 in field), which would put it 1.25 in through our walls. See CLAUDE.md, Zenith, Frame. The ledger counts it as this alliance's LOADING ZONE (ledger: loadingZone): SPEC, Competition Manual §9.3 and G427, humans enter NECTAR only through the LOADING ZONE.

SPEC, inherited from loadingZoneRed: its point mirror (Fig 9-2). The ledger counts it as this alliance's LOADING ZONE (ledger: loadingZone): SPEC, Competition Manual §9.3 and G427, humans enter NECTAR only through the LOADING ZONE.

humanPlayer.provenance: SPEC (BIOBUZZ Competition Manual V1 §10.3.1 B.ii, §10.1 and G426.A): each alliance's human player starts with 5 nectar in its ALLIANCE AREA, and may enter one of them each time that alliance's hive is TIPPED. G427.C puts an entered nectar on the tiles of the alliance's own LOADING ZONE. G426.B (all remaining nectar with 60 s or less left) is TELEOP only, so it never applies to an auto. DSim agrees: BB_NECTAR_COUNT 8 is 3 staged in the cell and 5 in stock, and bbHumanPlayerTick enters one per tip into the loading zone.
